# Awaken Spiritual Store

> Awaken Spiritual Store is a spiritual store, crystal shop, and metaphysical store in downtown Collingwood, Ontario, Canada. Opened in June 2018 by owner Penny, it offers healing crystals, natural crystals, crystal energy tools, tarot card decks, oracle cards, incense and smudging supplies, crystal jewellery, meditation supplies, spiritual books, and spiritual gifts.

Awaken is known locally as an inclusive place to learn, heal, grow, and shine. Customers can browse crystals Collingwood Ontario shoppers trust, explore open tarot and oracle decks, find mindfulness gifts and gifts for crystal lovers, and ask staff for guidance. Tarot readings and other in-store spiritual healing support may be available — ask in store for the current schedule.

- Legal name / brand: Awaken Spiritual Store
- Also known as: Spiritual Store Collingwood, Crystal Shop Collingwood, Metaphysical Store Collingwood
- Address: 207 Hurontario St Unit 2, Collingwood, ON L9Y 2M1, Canada
